blocks.text: Rainshutter preserves the act of opening a surface after passing weather. A window-like frame and gathered beads make the shortened name natural, while the written instructions retain its particular care function.
A weathered bronze oval window frame with a folded violet translucent membrane and ivory latch.
One-shot activation: Ivory latch flips up and the membrane rolls aside with a brief spray of tiny beads. The game performs the final fade.
20 silver. Infection severity −2; reaching zero clears the condition. Cleanliness +10; Health +6. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.

Original PixelLab artwork and opening animation, October 28, 2026. Generation 4b8dc784-a158-4760-be69-01e36c82f75b; animation 46c2140e-ee54-4936-8a22-ae66493520f2. The game performs the final fade; reduced motion holds a still.
